boundaries.workspace: Windows x64 fixed local NTFS only; existing UTF-8 files <=16384 bytes. Native holds root/ancestor/target handles, rejects reparse/existing-hardlink/device/metadata paths and verifies original SHA plus volume/file index. Replacement never writes original inode data: it protects and fills a host-private candidate, fsyncs/readbacks it, then uses ReplaceFile and verifies the pre-recorded new ID. This is a trusted file effect capability, not whole-workspace sandbox or disk quota.
boundaries.authority: Actual trusted local Human Kernel query on claim, pre-prepare, pre-dispatch, pre-commit and cached publication. Agent requests are still denied; no imported flag or selected path/actor/fresh ledger grants effects.
boundaries.custody: Project-fixed SQLite policy anchor, exact schema/digests and immutable records prevent journal API substitution and ordinary corruption. Same-permission local Human replacement/removal of the complete private ledger/anchor is outside this protection; production custody remains missing.
boundaries.recovery: Original Node host and prepared native worker must both be observed absent. Unknown identity remains held. Dispatched missing completion is Unknown even when file contents match. No auto replay effect, success inference, parent settlement or counter refund.
boundaries.filesystem_concurrency: Preimage/identity checks and ReplaceFile are separate operations, not OS digest compare-and-swap. Shared byte-range locks do not block existing memory-mapped writes. Same-permission Human interference in worktree/private staging is outside the protected Runtime boundary; production ownership/custody remains required. Graceful cancellation closes input and joins native cleanup; forced deadline termination may leave private staging residue, whose full original-resource cleanup remains unimplemented.
boundaries.capacity: 128 permanent calls, four 114688-byte bounded records per call =458752 bytes; default 58720256 bytes (56MiB) logical content. Unknown/not_started retain slots. SQLite/WAL physical disk quota is not implemented.
boundaries.observation: Default LocalRunVerifier reads original project ledger and validates original RunRecord operation/executor/context. Optional custom host ports must also install this trusted reader; this batch does not supply production Agent admission.
boundaries.tests: Actual native/Git scenarios use owned temporary repositories and real Native Human commands. No user source/project DB is modified through the broker. Constructed journal seams are separately identified.
boundaries.first_failure: Four initial read assertions hashed the raw test object property order instead of the normalized host input. Fixed the assertion and ensured owned native handles are discarded on assertion failure. Initial 20/24 pass and cleanup error report is retained, not rewritten.
boundaries.transport: Native stdout must have complete bounded frames and a verified process exit. Added rejection state for invalid/trailing output after an already-resolved frame; normal native paths and cancellation are tested, malformed broker output is not separately injected.
